title: Credit Department Circular: Consigned Exposure on VendPoint Start-Up Items
content:
The credit department limits how much consigned stock of the item most recently added to a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine Corbett builds up when it re-sizes that item's par in the start-up par review, according to the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

**Rule.** The consigned exposure factor follows the customer's open Commercial Credit Account, the account with no closed date: when that account's status is on hold or in collections, or two or more payments were returned on the customer's account in the twelve months ending today, the factor is the restricted exposure factor; when the account's status is active and exactly one payment was returned in those twelve months, the factor is the watch exposure factor; otherwise the factor is one; returned payments are counted by return date.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**Figures.** The restricted exposure factor is 0.5 and the watch exposure factor is 0.8.

| Open account status | Returned payments in the twelve months ending today | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| On hold | any number | 0.5 |
| In collections | any number | 0.5 |
| Active | 2 or more | 0.5 |
| Active | exactly 1 | 0.8 |
| Active | none | 1 |

Hypothetical dates, today 10 September: a payment returned on 11 September of the year before is eleven whole months back and counts; one returned on 10 September of the year before is twelve whole months back and does not count.
